first_row: Supplementary Data 1: Genes found to be significantly mutated in each histology subtype (and all samples combined) based on frequency of mutations in histology subtype and gene length.

Supplementary Data 2: Results of differential expression analysis comparing expression in leiomyosarcomas, GISTs, myxoid liposarcomas, WD/DDLPSs, or Ewing sarcomas against the rest of the tumor samples.  P values are derived from two-sided Fiscer Exact Test, unadjusted.  FDR is used to adjust for multiple testing.

Supplementary Data 3: Results of differential expression analysis comparing expression in the "cold" immune group (A and B), "hot" immune group (D and E), and immune group C against the rest of the tumor samples. P values are derived from two-sided Fiscer Exact Test, unadjusted.  FDR is used to adjust for multiple testing.

Supplementary Data 4: Results of differential expression analysis comparing expression GISTs assigned to the "cold" immune group (A and B), "hot" immune group (D and E), and immune group C against the rest of the GIST samples.  P values are derived from two-sided Fiscer Exact Test, unadjusted.  FDR is used to adjust for multiple testing.
